title: How AI avatar video generation works
text: A typical pipeline writes a short script with a language model, converts it to speech, animates a portrait to match the audio and composites the result over background footage.

title: Vertical video: why 9:16 dominates short-form platforms
text: Short-form platforms display video full-screen on phones, so 1080x1920 portrait clips avoid letterboxing and keep subjects large on screen.
